emptyHint: Add your mortgage to see the instalment, what you have paid so far, and the forecast to the final payment.

rates.title: Rate periods
rates.hint: One row per rate change: each euribor reset, or a fixed period. A mixed loan is a fixed row followed by variable ones. During a fixed period, spread cashback returns the spread of the variable period that follows. The earliest row is the opening rate.
rates.error: Every rate period needs a start month, and a euribor and spread, or a TAN if fixed.

prepayments.title: Early repayments
prepayments.hint: Capital repaid on top of an instalment. Lowers the instalment and leaves the term as it is. The fee is a % of the amount, prefilled with the usual one for the rate that month (0.5% variable, 2% fixed); 4% stamp duty is added on top of it.
prepayments.error: Every early repayment needs a month, an amount above zero and a fee between 0 and 100%.

costs.title: Up-front costs
costs.name: Description
costs.hint: Taxes and fees paid to take the loan — IMT, stamp duty, valuation.
costs.error: Every cost needs a description and an amount.

summary.totalCostHint: All interest, the up-front costs and the early repayment fees, less the spread cashback, on top of the capital borrowed.
summary.totalCostHintOffer: All interest, up-front and switching costs, early repayment fees, and the ticked monthly costs from the switch on, less cashback and the bank's incentives — for both banks, so the two compare like for like.
summary.offerMonthlyCosts: Monthly costs, rest of the loan

schedule.title: Forecast to the final instalment
schedule.caption: Assumes euribor holds at today's {{rate}}%. A reset changes every instalment after it.

cashback.title: Spread cashback
cashback.hint: Periods in which the bank returns the spread share of each instalment's interest after it is paid. Add another period when the offer is renewed.
cashback.error: Every cashback period needs a start and an end month, and cannot end before it starts.

monthlyCosts.title: Monthly extra costs
monthlyCosts.hint: Recurring costs that come with the loan but are not part of it — account fees, insurance. Tick a cost to count it in the total monthly cost, and tick stamp duty to add 4% on top of it, as on bank fees.
monthlyCosts.name: Description
monthlyCosts.error: Every monthly cost needs a description and an amount above zero.

simulator.title: Simulate early repayment
simulator.hint: Try a repayment and see what it does to the rest of the loan. Nothing here is saved.
simulator.pastMonth: Pick a month after the current one.
simulator.feeHint: Prefilled with the usual fee for the rate in force that month: 0.5% variable, 2% fixed. 4% stamp duty is added on top.

offers.startDate: First instalment at the new bank

startDateError.missing: Pick the month the loan would move.
startDateError.notFuture: Pick a month after the current one.
startDateError.afterLoanEnds: The loan has already ended by then.

offers.termMonthsHint: Instalments at the new bank. Starts as the months you have left.
offers.rateError: Fill in the rate: euribor and spread for the variable part, the TAN and its length for the fixed part.
offers.refundedInstalmentsHint: First instalments the bank pays back.
offers.refundedError: A whole number, no more than the term.
offers.switchingCostsHint: One-off costs of moving: valuation, dossier, registos, stamp duty.
offers.monthlyCostsHint: The new bank's account fee and required insurance. They replace your current monthly costs from the switch.
offers.cashbackHint: The new bank's spread cashback. Your current bank's campaigns stop at the switch. In a mixed offer it also runs during the fixed period: enter the real fixed TAN charged, not the advertised one net of the spread.

backup.invalidTitle: That file could not be imported
backup.confirmMessage_one: Importing replaces all your current loans with the {{count}} loan in the file.
backup.confirmMessage_other: Importing replaces all your current loans with the {{count}} loans in the file.
